verification_targets.description: Overall bounding-box extent along the X axis of the finished L-bracket
verification_targets.notes: Determined by BASE_LENGTH_X; both legs share the same X footprint

verification_targets.description: Overall bounding-box extent along the Y axis (base leg width)
verification_targets.notes: Determined by BASE_WIDTH_Y; vertical leg thickness is nested inside this extent

verification_targets.description: Overall bounding-box extent along Z measured from the base plane (Z=0)
verification_targets.notes: Absolute value: BRACKET_THICKNESS (4) + VERTICAL_LEG_HEIGHT_ABOVE_BASE (40) = 44

verification_targets.description: The base leg and vertical leg must fuse into exactly one connected solid
verification_targets.notes: Boolean union of the two legs must yield a single Body with no separate shells

functional_requirements: Joins two perpendicular surfaces at a 90 degree internal angle
Base leg mounts flat against a horizontal surface via two through-holes
Vertical leg mounts against a vertical surface via two through-holes
Holes sized for M4 fasteners (clearance diameter 4.2 mm)
Must be structurally rigid under light static load in the direction pushing the legs together
special_features: Part MUST be an L-shaped solid formed by exactly two perpendicular legs joined with a 90 degree internal angle at the inner corner
Both legs MUST share the same BRACKET_THICKNESS of 4 mm
The vertical leg MUST rise from the top of the base leg, so the total Z extent equals BRACKET_THICKNESS + VERTICAL_LEG_HEIGHT_ABOVE_BASE

Vertical-leg mounting holes MUST be through-holes oriented along the Y axis (perpendicular to the vertical plate), not the Z axis
All mounting holes MUST have diameter HOLE_DIAMETER_M4 = 4.2 mm and MUST be positioned at least HOLE_EDGE_MARGIN_X/HOLE_EDGE_MARGIN_Y from every outer edge of their respective leg
The part MUST be symmetric about the XZ plane (Y coordinates mirror about Y=0 for hole placement within each leg)

sketches.notes: Base leg of the L: 50 mm (X) x 40 mm (Y) rectangle centered on the XY origin, spans X=-25..+25, Y=-20..+20. Extruded +Z from the base plane (Z=0) to give the base leg Z=0..4.

Vertical leg of the L, drawn on the XZ plane located at Y=-20 (rear face). Sketch-local x = world X, sketch-local y = world Z. Rectangle 50 mm wide x 44 mm tall centered at local (0, 22) so it spans local x=-25..+25 (world X=-25..+25) and local y=0..44 (world Z=0..44). The profile deliberately runs from Z=0 THROUGH the base leg (Z=0..4) so the 4 mm extrusion overlaps the base volume and the two bodies can be unioned. Above the base top the leg rises VERTICAL_LEG_HEIGHT_ABOVE_BASE = 40 mm (Z=4..44), giving a 90 degree internal corner between the top of the base leg and the front face of the vertical leg at (Y=-16, Z=4).

steps.label: Extrude base leg plate 50x40x4
steps.notes: Base leg Z=0..4, X=-25..25, Y=-20..20. Constitutes the horizontal leg of the L-bracket.

steps.label: Extrude vertical leg plate 50x44x4 along +Y from Y=-20
steps.notes: Vertical leg occupies X=-25..25, Y=-20..-16, Z=0..44 before union. The Z=0..4 portion is buried inside the base leg (shared volume), guaranteeing a solid boolean overlap. Resulting L has a 90 degree internal angle at the corner (Y=-16, Z=4).

steps.label: Fuse base leg and vertical leg into a single L-shaped solid
steps.notes: Both legs share BRACKET_THICKNESS = 4 mm and a 90 degree internal corner; the overlap region Z=0..4, Y=-20..-16 fuses them into exactly one connected Body (verification target 'single-body'). Overall extents after union: X=50, Y=40, Z=44.

steps.label: Base-leg M4 clearance through-hole at X=-15
steps.notes: Through-hole along Z (perpendicular to the base plate), base leg Z=0..4. Axis vertical; drill with overshoot above Z=4 and below Z=0. Center X=-15 = -HOLE_PITCH_X/2 = -15, i.e. HOLE_EDGE_MARGIN_X = 10 mm from the X=-25 outer edge. Center Y=0 (20 mm from the rear edge Y=-20 and 20 mm from the front edge Y=+20), so the hole lies on the XZ symmetry plane and mirrors onto the hole at X=+15.

steps.label: Base-leg M4 clearance through-hole at X=+15
steps.notes: Through-hole along Z, base leg Z=0..4. Center X=+15 = +HOLE_PITCH_X/2, giving HOLE_EDGE_MARGIN_X = 10 mm from the X=+25 outer edge. Pair of base holes is symmetric about the XZ plane (X=+/-15, Y=0).

steps.label: Vertical-leg M4 clearance through-hole, lower (Z=11)
steps.notes: Through-hole along Y (perpendicular to the vertical plate, NOT along Z), vertical leg plate spans Y=-20..-16. Z = HOLE_CENTER_Z_ABOVE_BASE - HOLE_PITCH_Z/2 = 26 - 15 = 11. Cylinder axis parallel to Y, cut with generous overshoot on both sides (e.g. Y=-60..+60) so the shell stays closed; it passes only through the vertical leg since Z=11 is well above the base leg (Z=0..4). X=0 places it on the XZ symmetry plane.

steps.label: Vertical-leg M4 clearance through-hole, upper (Z=41)
steps.notes: Through-hole along Y, vertical leg Y=-20..-16. Z = HOLE_CENTER_Z_ABOVE_BASE + HOLE_PITCH_Z/2 = 26 + 15 = 41, i.e. HOLE_PITCH_Z = 30 mm apart from the lower hole and centered on HOLE_CENTER_Z_ABOVE_BASE = 26 above the base plane. Upper hole edge is at Z=43.1, 0.9 mm below the leg top (Z=44). X=0 lies on the XZ symmetry plane.

revision_history.note: Initial design: base leg 50x40x4 at Z=0..4, vertical leg 50x4x40 at Y=-20..-16 rising to Z=44, 90 deg internal corner, 2 base-leg Z-axis through-holes at X=+/-15/Y=0, 2 vertical-leg Y-axis through-holes at X=0/Z=11 and Z=41, all 4.2 mm M4 clearance.
